design.purpose: A warm, stretchy neck cowl for one adult, worked seamlessly in joined rounds with a green-to-blue colour block.

steps.c: Place yarns, hook, scissors, needle and tape ready
Leave 15 cm tail, chain 32, join in ring
Rnd 1: ch 2, 32 hdc in each chain, join, no turn
Rnd 2: ch 2, 32 green hdc in each stitch, join
Measure around tube for 64 cm circumference
Rnd 3: ch 2, 32 green hdc in each stitch, join
Rnd 4: ch 2, 32 green hdc in each stitch, join
Rnd 5: ch 2, 32 green hdc in each stitch, join
Rnd 6: ch 2, 32 green hdc in each stitch, join
Cut green yarn, leaving 15 cm tail
Rnd 7: join blue with 15 cm tail, 32 hdc, join
Rnd 8: ch 2, 32 blue hdc in each stitch, join
Rnd 9: ch 2, 32 blue hdc in each stitch, join
Rnd 10: ch 2, 32 blue hdc in each stitch, join
Rnd 11: ch 2, 32 blue hdc in each stitch, join
Rnd 12: ch 2, 32 blue hdc in each stitch, join
Cut blue yarn leaving 15 cm, pull through loop
Weave all 4 tails through nearby stitches securely
